spots.desc: This is a great place to chill with a beer and watch the sunset while reclining on "tea beds" on the beach.

spots.name: Ko Kaeo
spots.local: เกาะแก้ว
spots.desc: An offshore isle about 3 km out from Rawai. Can be reached in 30 min by boat. It offers picturesque beaches and underwater scenery. There is also a replica of the holy footprint on the island.

spots.name: Laem Phromthep
spots.local: Phromthep Cape แหลมพรหมเทพ
spots.desc: Literally translated as "God's Cape", Phromthep is one of the island's most notable natural landmarks and lies to the far south, around 2 km from Rawai. With high cliffs and uninterrupted views, Phromthep Cape is known for its dramatic sunsets, which regularly attract crowds. At the summit you can visit the lighthouse and a small and interesting shrine featuring elephants prominently.

spots.name: Phuket Sea Shell Museum
spots.local: (พิพิธภัณฑ์เปลือกหอยภูเก็ต
spots.desc: The emphasis is on shells from Thai waters, which are among the most sought-after by collectors, however, shells from every part of the world are featured. There are numerous rarities and freaks including what may be the world's largest golden pearl, large sections of sedimentary rock containing shell fossils, and a shell that weighs 250 kg.

spots.name: PhuketFit Retreat
spots.desc: Health & fitness retreat for detoxification and fitness services.

spots.name: Moo's
spots.desc: Great Thai food. Open late. Just look for the many parked motorbikes and the prominent sign.

spots.name: Nikita's Beach Restaurant
spots.desc: Waterfront dining. Fresh seafood, international food, wood-fired pizza.

spots.name: Laguna Plaza
spots.desc: A complex of themed bars. A great place to have a few drinks, play some pool, or just chill out and listen to some music before the adjoining Laguna Club opens its doors at 02:00 where tourists and locals party until the sun comes up.

spots.name: Patcharin Seafood
spots.desc: Don't be scared off by the decrepit appearance, this is the oldest eatery on the beach and still does a roaring business serving up tasty and cheap food. The Thai food is authentic and delicious, and the Western food is, well, generously portioned. Basic noodles start from 60 baht and a huge pot of tom yum kung goes for 150 baht.

spots.name: Nok Seafood
spots.desc: Thai and Western food on a raised platform above the beach, with little luxuries like a tablecloth. Thai dishes here are a cut above the competition.

spots.name: Positano
spots.desc: Kitschy Italian eatery run by a voluble Italian guy. The wood-fired pizza is good (from 220 baht), but the haphazard and overpriced pasta dishes are best avoided. Wine menu is limited to one red and white each.

spots.name: Catch Beach Club
spots.desc: Surin's only nightspot worthy of the name, with slick, billowing white sails, lit-up palm trees, roaring fires, several fully-stocked bars and a menu of expensive, pretentious fusion food. Also open during the day, but lounger rental goes for a ridiculous 1,500 baht if you're not a guest at the Twin Palms Resort.

spots.name: Bulone Minimart
spots.desc: Sells snacks, water and other basic items such as toothpaste, shampoo and mosquito repellent.

spots.name: Farang / Charlie Beach
spots.desc: The more popular of the two beaches and good for watching the sunset.

spots.name: Tham Morakot
spots.desc: Accessible from Farang Beach by boat or kayak. Expect tour rates to start at 600 baht before haggling and kayaks at 100 baht per hour. The cave is accessible only at low tide, and takes about 30 minutes to reach by kayak from Charlie Beach. Bringing a light source is recommended, as the cave is 80 m long and has some sharp turns. Beyond the cave is an attractive, small, completely enclosed beach…

spots.name: Bike rental
spots.desc: Rent a mountain bike from PK minimiart and explore the island.

spots.name: Hilltop Restaurant
spots.desc: Cheapest meals on the island, with a menagerie of animals and very friendly staff.

spots.name: Mong Bar
spots.desc: A nice beach bar playing good music. Sometimes with live performances from Thai reggae bands. A good place to watch the sunset. Beers start at 50 baht and cocktails at 100 baht.

spots.name: Wat Tham Khao Rup Chang
spots.local: วัดถ้ำเขารูปช้าง
spots.desc: The temple uses the cave as religious ground. The cave has been partitioned into several rooms with delicate stalactites and stalagmites. The surroundings are peaceful and shaded by trees.

spots.name: Ko Yao
spots.desc: Small island, just a few minutes walk away from Wat Chonlathara Singhe. A wooden bridge crossing the Tak Bai River leads to the island. The atmosphere is very tranquil, and it seems there are no shops around, so better bring water with you.

spots.name: Wat Chonlathara Singhe
spots.desc: A historically important small temple in a now huge temple compound. When the Tak Bai territory was partitioned between Siam and the Great Britain in 1909, Siam held Buddhism and the temple as reasons to bargain over the division. The English accepted and the territory stayed with Siam. When visiting the temple in early 2011, there was a heavy military presence on the temple grounds, but you are…

spots.name: Golden Dome Cabaret
spots.desc: Another one of Bangkok's typical ladyboy shows.

spots.name: Robinson
spots.local: โรบินสัน

spots.name: Tha Beatlounge
spots.desc: Dining and dancing with mainly rap and hip hop type music.
spots.addr: 21/127 Royal City Avenue Rd. Block D

spots.name: Merkus Pine Forest Nature Trail
spots.local: ป่าสนสองใบ
spots.desc: This nature trail showcases the unique flora in the region.

spots.name: Taphoen Thong Cave
